sub_site: whole blood (myocardial infarction vs healthy); saliva not extracted

evidence.quote: we enrolled 10 healthy individuals and 10 confirmed patients with MI from the Qinghai People’s Hospital
universal primer set was used to amplify the V3-V4 region of 16S rRNA gene
the OTUs with abundance <0.005% were filtered

notes: 10 MI + 10 controls, blood and saliva; only blood extracted. Only Bacteroides named as most abundant blood genus; full genus profile in Fig 6B. Lactobacillus only from own blood correlation results stated in Discussion. Oral genera (Veillonella, Prevotella_7, Rothia etc.) excluded. No negative controls.
